# world-layout v0.3
#
# This file is machine-written and machine-parsed. Humans DO NOT edit this file.
# Humans provide natural-language inputs (NL lines). These lines are immutable.
#
# Agents extract two things from the cumulative NL inputs:
#   (1) PHENOMENA       — behaviors or patterns that unfold over time
#   (2) DIMENSIONALITIES — variables/properties that can change over time
#
# Only PHEN and DIM represent the agent’s current best interpretation of the
# world described by ALL NL lines so far. These interpretations MAY be revised.
# PHEN/DIM snapshots appear after each NL line to show the full world state
# after processing that NL; the most recent snapshot is the current state.
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   - NL is append-only, preserved exactly as written.
#   - After every NL line, append the full PHEN/DIM snapshot reflecting the
#     world state after incorporating that NL (including any changes it
#     triggered). Duplication is expected; clarity is prioritized over size.
#   - PHEN and DIM MAY be replaced, updated, or superseded as understanding improves.
#   - Agent must ensure PHEN/DIM always reflect the most accurate world model.
#
# Example:
#   NL "a ball is dropped"
#   -> agent may infer PHEN falling; DIM height, velocity, gravity_strength
#
#   NL "on planet earth"
#   -> agent must revise previous DIM gravity_strength=9.8 m/s^2
#      if it had assumed another value or left it unspecified.
#
# PHENOMENON (PHEN):
#   Something that happens or unfolds over time.
#   Examples: "ball falls", "trucks queue", "inventory oscillates"
#
# DIMENSIONALITY (DIM):
#   A variable whose value may change over time.
#   Examples: position, velocity, queue_length, gravitational_strength
#
# SYNTAX:
#   NL <verbatim user text>
#   PHEN <id> description="<text>"
#   DIM  <id> description="<text>"
#
# RULES:
#   - NL is append-only and preserved verbatim.
#   - Each PHEN/DIM snapshot collectively represents the world interpretation
#     after processing that NL; the latest snapshot is the current state.
#   - PHEN/DIM MUST be updated when new NL changes meaning or invalidates assumptions.
#   - Agents may modify or replace PHEN/DIM lines, but must not modify NL lines.
#   - PHEN/DIM lines should follow the NL that triggered their creation or change.
#   - PHEN/DIM ids must be lowercase snake_case.
#   - Descriptions must be quoted strings.
#
# End of header.
NL 11x11 maze
PHEN maze_structure description="A static maze layout exists on an 11 by 11 grid."
DIM  maze_dimensions description="The maze spans 11 columns by 11 rows."
NL there's a traverser in the maze
PHEN maze_structure description="A static maze layout exists on an 11 by 11 grid."
PHEN traverser_movement description="A traverser navigates through the maze's grid cells."
DIM  maze_dimensions description="The maze spans 11 columns by 11 rows."
DIM  traverser_position description="The traverser's location within the maze grid, likely expressed as row and column coordinates."
NL there can be multiple traversers
PHEN maze_structure description="A static maze layout exists on an 11 by 11 grid."
PHEN traverser_movement description="Multiple traversers navigate through the maze's grid cells."
DIM  maze_dimensions description="The maze spans 11 columns by 11 rows."
DIM  traverser_positions description="Locations of each traverser within the maze grid, likely expressed as row and column coordinates per traverser."
DIM  traverser_count description="The number of traversers currently present in the maze."
NL each traverser has his own algorithm
PHEN maze_structure description="A static maze layout exists on an 11 by 11 grid."
PHEN traverser_movement description="Multiple traversers navigate through the maze's grid cells, each following its own distinct algorithmic strategy."
DIM  maze_dimensions description="The maze spans 11 columns by 11 rows."
DIM  traverser_positions description="Locations of each traverser within the maze grid, likely expressed as row and column coordinates per traverser."
DIM  traverser_count description="The number of traversers currently present in the maze."
DIM  traverser_algorithms description="The specific navigation algorithm or strategy assigned to each traverser guiding its movement decisions."
NL traversers do not know the map ahead of time
PHEN maze_structure description="A static maze layout exists on an 11 by 11 grid."
PHEN traverser_movement description="Multiple traversers navigate through the maze's grid cells, each following its own distinct algorithmic strategy without prior knowledge of the maze layout."
PHEN map_exploration description="Traversers explore and gradually discover the maze layout as they move."
DIM  maze_dimensions description="The maze spans 11 columns by 11 rows."
DIM  traverser_positions description="Locations of each traverser within the maze grid, likely expressed as row and column coordinates per traverser."
DIM  traverser_count description="The number of traversers currently present in the maze."
DIM  traverser_algorithms description="The specific navigation algorithm or strategy assigned to each traverser guiding its movement decisions, operating without prior map knowledge."
DIM  traverser_map_knowledge description="Each traverser's internal understanding of the maze layout, initially empty and growing as they explore."
NL some traversers have a special ability, they can branch search, where they duplicate themselves and share a global memory of where they visited
PHEN maze_structure description="A static maze layout exists on an 11 by 11 grid."
PHEN traverser_movement description="Multiple traversers navigate through the maze's grid cells using distinct algorithms without prior map knowledge; some can branch into concurrent copies."
PHEN map_exploration description="Traversers explore and gradually discover the maze layout as they move, with findings accumulating across branches."
PHEN branching_search description="Branch-capable traversers duplicate themselves to search in parallel, coordinating via shared memory of visited cells."
DIM  maze_dimensions description="The maze spans 11 columns by 11 rows."
DIM  traverser_positions description="Locations of each traverser and any spawned branches within the maze grid, likely expressed as row and column coordinates per instance."
DIM  traverser_count description="The number of traverser instances currently present in the maze, including any branched copies."
DIM  traverser_algorithms description="The specific navigation algorithm or strategy assigned to each traverser, including whether branching search is used."
DIM  traverser_map_knowledge description="Each traverser's internal understanding of the maze layout, initially empty and growing as they explore; branch-capable traversers can rely on shared global visitation memory."
DIM  branching_capable_traversers description="Which traversers have the ability to branch into duplicate instances for parallel search."
DIM  shared_visited_memory description="A global record of visited maze cells maintained and shared among branched traverser instances."
